params.name: rendezvous_stride
params.description: Perform the CPU gloo rendezvous every k-th guarded allreduce in program order across both call sites (1 = before every collective, the projected optimum). Choices 2 and 3 trade residual inter-rank skew on skipped collectives for fewer barrier round trips if step_ms overhead binds. The allreduce operands, process group, ReduceOp, async semantics and all workload/quality thresholds are identical for every choice; stride only gates whether a barrier precedes a given submission, and the event counter advances identically on all ranks.

external_invariants: Workload frozen at world_size=2, micro_batch=1, sequence_length=128, accumulation_steps=4: effective training batch 8 and 1024 tokens per step must not change.

Numerical policy frozen: float32 parameters and compute, TF32 disabled for matmul and cudnn, float32_matmul_precision('highest'), cudnn.benchmark False, all dropout probabilities 0, eager attention, use_cache False.
Seeds frozen: torch.manual_seed(20261020) for global RNG and model initialization; per-rank inputs from torch.Generator().manual_seed(31000 + rank).
Loss semantics frozen: each micro-batch loss divided by accumulation_steps (4), one backward per micro-batch, reported loss is the sum of the four scaled detached micro losses.

Communication semantics frozen: DDP with bucket_cap_mb=25, gradient_as_bucket_view=True, broadcast_buffers=False; no_sync() on the first three micro-steps with the full gradient all-reduce on the fourth backward, followed by optimizer.step().
Optimizer frozen: SGD lr=0.001, momentum=0.0, weight_decay=0.0, foreach=False, with optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True) inside the measured step.
Repetition semantics frozen: every measured step starts from the identical initial parameters via the CPU state_dict snapshot, so repeats reproduce the source's reset/step loop.

Correctness observation schema frozen: {loss: scalar loss tensor, gradients: full parameter-name to gradient tensor mapping of the unwrapped model, parameters: full parameter-name to updated tensor mapping of the unwrapped model}.

Required communication observations (collective_identity, logical_payload, cross_rank_collectives) are collected and validated by the framework; the adapter installs no communication hook and inventories no buckets during measured runs.
The objective constraint requires step_ms <= 1.05x baseline; no accuracy or convergence claim beyond the source's reference-fidelity checks.

Model construction, weight seeding, input generation and the gloo control group are outside timed execution; only the source step body (zero_grad, accumulation with its communication, optimizer update) is measured.
